fullDescription: A sticky two-tier ecommerce utility navbar in white, ink, and a single sale-red: a black utility strip above a white main bar with a bag-icon wordmark, a search-first inline field with an 'All' dropdown and red submit, an account chip plus a cart icon with a live red count badge and a black 'Sell with us' CTA, over a hairline category rail whose links grow a red underline on hover.

structured.summary: A sticky two-tier ecommerce utility navbar in white, near-black ink, and a single sale-red accent: a thin black utility strip (shipping + support left, find-a-store + sale link right) sits above a white main bar that pairs a bag-icon wordmark ('Forge.Supply') with a search-first inline field (an 'All' department dropdown + input + a red submit button), an account 'Sign in' chip and a cart icon carrying a live red count badge, and a black 'Sell with us' CTA, with a third hairline category rail below (Shop all, Power Tools, Hand Tools, Hardware, Workwear, Deals + a 'Hot' pill, Brands) whose links grow a red underline on hover. Built entirely on Inter with Solar icons, it pins flush to the top and reflows down to a single icon row + a scrollable category rail on mobile.

style.description: A crisp, high-contrast retail / hardware-storefront aesthetic on a clean white canvas with near-black ink (#0a0a0a) text and one hot sale-red accent (#e5341f, darker #c42912 on hover) used only for commerce signals: the search submit, the cart count badge, the 'Sale' link, discount tags, the 'Hot' pill, and category underlines. Everything else is monochrome ink at opacities. The whole UI is set in Inter (400 to 900) with tight tracking on the wordmark and headings, so weight and the single red punch carry hierarchy. Depth is quiet: a soft hairline-plus-faint-drop nav shadow and 1px ink borders, never heavy chrome.
style.prompt: Use a clean retail storefront design system: a white page background (#ffffff) with near-black ink text #0a0a0a (named token 'ink', used at full strength and at /70 /60 /50 /45 /40 /15 /12 /10 /8 /5 opacities for hierarchy and hairlines) and ONE hot sale-red accent #e5341f (token 'sale') with a darker hover #c42912 (token 'sale-dark'). Reserve the red strictly for commerce signals: the search submit button, the cart count badge, the top-strip 'Sale' price-tag link, product discount tags, the 'Hot' deals pill, and the category-link hover underline; everything structural stays monochrome ink. Subtle neutrals: a #fafafa search-field fill and #f4f4f4 product-image placeholder. Typography is a single family, Inter from Google Fonts (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900); the wordmark and section headings use font-black/extrabold with very tight tracking (a custom .tracking-tightest at letter-spacing -0.04em), nav labels are 13.5px font-medium, the utility strip is 12 to 12.5px. Icons come from Iconify's Solar set (solar:bolt-bold, headphones-round-bold, map-point-bold, tag-price-bold, bag-4-bold, magnifer-linear, alt-arrow-down-linear, user-linear, cart-large-2-linear, widget-5-bold, delivery-bold). Depth is restrained: a custom 'nav' box-shadow ('0 1px 0 0 rgba(10,10,10,0.08), 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(10,10,10,0.18)') under the white bar and a tiny 'field' shadow on the search input, plus 1px ink-opacity borders and a white-ring red 'badge-ring' shadow around the cart count; no gradients, no heavy chrome.

layout_and_structure.description: A `sticky top-0 z-50` `<header>` stacking three full-width tiers that share one centered `mx-auto max-w-[1240px] px-5 sm:px-8` column: (1) a thin black utility strip (h-9) with left info (free shipping, weekday support) and right links (find a store, a red-tagged Sale link); (2) a white main bar (h-[68px] sm:h-[72px], with the soft 'nav' shadow) holding the wordmark on the left, a flexible inline search field in the middle (hidden below md, capped at max-w-[560px]), and a right cluster of account + cart + a black 'Sell with us' CTA; (3) a category rail (h-12) separated by a 1px top hairline, with a horizontally scrollable row of category links on the left and a 'Track an order' affordance on the right (xl only). Below md the search field hides and is replaced by a search-toggle icon, the account label collapses to an icon, and the CTA + 'Track an order' drop, leaving an icon row over a scrollable category rail.

prompts.partPt: Sticky three-tier Menu do Topo shell
prompts.prompt: Wrap the whole nav in a `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50">` containing three stacked full-bleed tiers in order: a black utility strip, a white main bar, and a category-rail `<nav>`. Each tier centers its content in the SAME `mx-auto max-w-[1240px] px-5 sm:px-8` container so all three rows share one column edge-to-edge. The header pins flush to the top of the viewport and the page scrolls beneath it.

A `bg-ink text-white text-[12px] sm:text-[12.5px]` strip whose inner container is `h-9 flex items-center justify-between gap-4`. Left group (`flex items-center gap-5`): a 'Free 2-day shipping over $75' item with a `solar:bolt-bold` icon at white/70, and a md-and-up 'Mon to Fri support . 9 to 6 ET' item in white/60 with a `solar:headphones-round-bold` icon. Right group (`flex items-center gap-4 sm:gap-5 whitespace-nowrap`): a sm-and-up 'Find a store' link (white/70 hover:white, `solar:map-point-bold`) and a 'Sale: up to 40% off' link in white with a sale-red `solar:tag-price-bold` icon and font-semibold label.

A `bg-white shadow-nav` tier whose inner row is `h-[68px] sm:h-[72px] flex items-center gap-4 sm:gap-6`. It lays out three zones left to right: the wordmark (shrink-0), the inline search form (flex-1, hidden below md), then the account+cart+CTA cluster (shrink-0). On mobile a `flex-1 md:hidden` spacer replaces the hidden search so the cluster stays right-aligned.

An anchor `flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0 group`: a `w-9 h-9 rounded-[10px] bg-ink text-white grid place-items-center` tile holding a `solar:bag-4-bold` icon (19px) that turns sale-red on group hover, beside an Inter `text-[21px] sm:text-[22px] font-black tracking-tightest leading-none` wordmark reading 'Forge' + a sale-red '.' + 'Supply'.

A `<form role="search">` `hidden md:flex flex-1 max-w-[560px] items-stretch h-11 rounded-xl border border-ink/12 bg-[#fafafa] shadow-field overflow-hidden` with a focus-within state (`focus-within:border-ink/30 focus-within:bg-white`). Inside, left to right: a lg-only 'All' department button (`px-3.5 border-r border-ink/10 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink/60` + a `solar:alt-arrow-down-linear` caret), a flex-1 transparent text input (`placeholder:text-ink/40 outline-none`, placeholder 'Search tools, parts, brands...'), and a sale-red submit button (`m-1 px-4 rounded-lg bg-sale hover:bg-sale-dark text-white grid place-items-center` with a `solar:magnifer-linear` icon).

prompts.partPt: Account + cart + Chamada Final para Ação cluster (right zone)
prompts.prompt: A `flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2 shrink-0` group: a md-hidden search-toggle icon button (w-10 h-10), then a sm-and-up account link (`h-11 pl-2.5 pr-3.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-ink/5` with a circular `solar:user-linear` avatar in a ink/15 ring and a lg-only two-line 'Account / Sign in' label) with an icon-only fallback below sm, then a cart icon link (relative `w-11 h-11`, `solar:cart-large-2-linear`) carrying an absolute sale-red count badge, then a lg-only 1px ink/10 divider and a black `h-11 px-5 rounded-lg bg-ink text-white text-[13.5px] font-semibold` 'Sell with us' CTA that turns sale-red on hover.

A `<nav class="border-t border-ink/8">` whose inner row is `h-12 flex items-center justify-between gap-6`. Left: a `flex items-center gap-6 sm:gap-7 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink/70` row of category links (each `.cat-link shrink-0`) - an active 'Shop all' (solid ink, font-semibold, sale-red `solar:widget-5-bold` icon), Power Tools, Hand Tools, Hardware, Workwear, a 'Deals' link with a small sale-red/12 'Hot' pill, and a sm-and-up 'Brands' with a caret. Right (xl only): a muted 'Track an order' item with a `solar:delivery-bold` icon. Hide the scrollbar via a `.no-scrollbar` rule (webkit + ms + firefox).

Below md, hide the inline search form and show a search-toggle icon button instead (a `flex-1 md:hidden` spacer keeps the right cluster pinned). Below sm, collapse the account link to an icon-only button and hide the 'Find a store' strip link; the 'All' department button and the two-line account label are lg-only; the 'Sell with us' CTA and the divider are lg-only; 'Track an order' is xl-only; the support item in the strip is md-and-up; 'Brands' is sm-and-up. The category rail stays a single horizontally scrollable row at all widths.

special_ui_components.prompt: Make the search the visual center of the bar: a single rounded `h-11` field that fuses three parts into one control - a left 'All' department dropdown button divided by a 1px rule, a flex-1 input, and an inset sale-red submit button (margin-1 so it floats inside the rounded shell). Give the whole field a `#fafafa` rest fill that brightens to white with a darker border on focus-within, so focusing the input lights the entire control.

The cart is an icon-only link with an absolutely-positioned count badge pinned to the top-right of the icon: a `min-w-[18px] h-[18px] rounded-full bg-sale text-white text-[10.5px] font-bold tabular-nums` pill reading '3', wrapped in a custom `.badge-ring` box-shadow ('0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(229,52,31,0.45)') so a 2px white ring separates it from the icon. The link's aria-label spells out the count ('Cart, 3 items').

Each category-rail link is a `.cat-link` with a `::after` 1px sale-red bar pinned 13px below it (`bottom: -13px` so it lands on the rail's bottom edge), hidden via `transform: scaleX(0)` from `transform-origin: left`, animating to `scaleX(1)` on hover or on the `[data-active]` link over 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1).

Frame the main bar with a black utility strip above (microcopy: shipping threshold, support hours, find-a-store, a red sale link) and a hairline-separated category rail below, so the navbar reads as a full retail storefront header (promo + browse + transact) rather than a single link row. Keep the red strictly for commerce signals (sale link, submit, badge, discount tags, 'Hot' pill, active underline).

structured.special_notes: Single typeface: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900); the wordmark and headings use font-black/extrabold with a custom .tracking-tightest (-0.04em). Exact color tokens (Tailwind config): ink #0a0a0a (all structural text + hairlines, used at /70 /60 /50 /45 /40 /15 /12 /10 /8 /5), sale #e5341f and sale-dark #c42912 (the only accent, hover only on interactive red), plus neutral fills #ffffff (page + bar), #fafafa (search field rest), #f4f4f4 (product-image placeholder). Icons are Iconify Solar (bolt-bold, headphones-round-bold, map-point-bold, tag-price-bold, bag-4-bold, magnifer-linear, alt-arrow-down-linear, user-linear, cart-large-2-linear, widget-5-bold, delivery-bold, plus screwdriver/plug/ruler/box on the demo product cards). Custom shadows: 'nav' = '0 1px 0 0 rgba(10,10,10,0.08), 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(10,10,10,0.18)' under the white bar; 'field' = a tiny input shadow; 'badge-ring' = a 2px white ring around the cart count. The header is `sticky top-0 z-50` and pins flush; all three tiers share the centered `max-w-[1240px] px-5 sm:px-8` column. Built with the Tailwind CDN. The page beneath (a dotted-grain hero with a red-accented H1 'built for real catalogs', CTA buttons, and a 4-up product-card grid) is demo context so the sticky bar has something to scroll over; the prompt-library value is the navbar pattern itself.
